children: South Korea’s industrial production increased 0.2% month-on-month in July 2026, easing sharply from an upwardly revised 6.7% rise in June.

It was the second consecutive month of growth in industrial production, though the pace slowed sharply from the strongest growth since February 2009, recorded in June, with manufacturing growth slowing sharply (0.2% vs 7.0% in June), supported by the electronic component segment.
Manufacturing production eased for both domestic (1.1% vs 3.9%) and overseas (3.1% vs 5.1%) demand.
Meanwhile, services activity fell 1.3%, reversing a 0.9% increase in the previous month.
On an annual basis, industrial production rose 3.6% in July, after an upwardly revised 6.0% surge in June.

title: South Korea Industrial Output Growth Eases to 0.2%
